title: How many mistakes does it take to learn an interval? Exact Littlestone dimensions of intervals and their unions
abstract: arXiv:2611.28727v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Littlestone dimension of a hypothesis class equals the smallest number of mistakes an online learner can guarantee against an adaptive adversary. For discrete intervals and unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points, only its order of growth was known. We determine it exactly. For every switch budget $k$ (with both end labels fixed when $k$ is odd), the smallest size on which $d$ mistakes can be forced follows a three-regime law: $d+1$ while $d\le k$, then $2d-k+1$, and beyond $d=\lceil 3k/2\rceil+k-1$ doubling the size adds exactly $k$ mistakes. Unions of $j$ intervals on $m$ points correspond to $k=2j$ and size $m+1$, and a single interval gives the thresholds $1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,\dots$. The natural learner that waits for a positive example and binary-searches both endpoints is not optimal: it can be forced into one extra mistake for 50,847 of the domain sizes below $10^5$. Upper bounds come from a gap potential and a block-pairing lear

translated_title: 学习一个区间需要多少次错误？区间及其并集的精确 Littlestone 维数
translated_abstract: 假设类的 Littlestone 维数等于在线学习者在面对自适应对手时所能保证的最少犯错次数。对于 m 个点上的离散区间以及 j 个区间的并集，此前人们只知道其增长阶，而我们给出了精确值。对每个切换预算 k（当 k 为奇数时两端的标签被固定），能强迫 d 次错误的最小规模遵循一个三段式规律：当 d≤k 时为 d+1，随后为 2d−k+1，而在 d 超过 ⌈3k/2⌉+k−1 之后，规模每翻倍恰好增加 k 次错误。m 个点上 j 个区间的并集对应于 k=2j 且规模为 m+1，而单个区间给出阈值序列 1,2,3,5,7,10,14,20,…。等待正样本出现再对两个端点做二分搜索的自然学习算法并非最优：在 10^5 以下的所有域规模中，有 50,847 个规模可使其被迫多犯一次错误。上界来自间隙势函数与块配对学习器（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文精确确定了离散区间与区间并集的 Littlestone 维数，证明强迫 d 次错误所需的最小域规模遵循一个三段式规律，并发现常见的“等待正样本后二分搜索端点”学习算法并非最优。
en_tdlr: This paper exactly determines the Littlestone dimensions of discrete intervals and unions of intervals via a three-regime law for the minimum domain size needed to force d mistakes under switch budget k, and proves that the natural wait-then-binary-search learner is not optimal.
